skill.name: agent-tools
skill.description: Use the inference.sh CLI to discover, run, and track cloud AI apps for images, video, LLMs, search, 3D, and Twitter/X automation.
skill.summary: Guides inference.sh CLI use for cloud AI app discovery, execution, authentication, and task tracking.
skill.author: inference-sh-0

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms critical pipe-to-shell installer recommendations and medium-risk external command usage through the infsh CLI. Many URL, credential-name, filesystem, and reconnaissance alerts are documentation false positives, but the skill still has high contextual risk because it can run broad cloud AI jobs and automate Twitter/X actions.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-sh instructions with package manager installation, signed release downloads, checksum verification, and a command users can inspect before execution.

remediation.issue: Bash permission allows every infsh subcommand.
remediation.suggestion: Limit allowed commands to the smallest safe set, and require confirmation before running apps, saving files, deploying apps, or starting billable jobs.

remediation.issue: Social media commands can change external accounts.
remediation.suggestion: Add mandatory preview and explicit approval steps before posting, sending direct messages, following, liking, or reposting through Twitter/X apps.
Document secret handling practices, including avoiding shell history, logs, committed files, and prompts that expose INFSH_API_KEY values.

content.value_statement: Finding and running cloud AI models through a CLI can take repeated lookup and setup steps. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical commands for inference.sh discovery, execution, and task tracking.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation, login, API key setup, update, and basic authentication checks for the infsh CLI.
Shows how to list, search, filter, and inspect available inference.sh apps.
Explains running cloud apps with inline inputs, input files, version pins, and no-wait jobs.
Shows task tracking, result retrieval, and saving outputs from completed cloud jobs.
Covers image, video, audio, LLM, search, 3D, utility, and Twitter/X app categories.
Documents shell completions and common CLI troubleshooting steps.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account, installed infsh CLI, authentication, and available service credits.
Cloud app availability, pricing, and model behavior can change outside the skill.
Inputs and generated outputs may be processed by external providers.
The skill does not independently verify each app policy, cost, or safety profile.

use_cases.title: Explore Cloud AI Apps
use_cases.description: Find image, video, audio, text, search, and 3D apps before choosing one to run.

use_cases.title: Run Repeatable AI Jobs
use_cases.description: Prepare input files, execute a selected app, and track long-running tasks from the command line.

use_cases.title: Manage Model Experiments
use_cases.description: Compare model options and collect outputs for product research, demos, or creative review.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up inference.sh
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the safest setup path for inference.sh, including install, login, and how to check authentication.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Model App
prompt_templates.prompt: Find inference.sh apps for [task], compare likely options, and explain what I should inspect before running one.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me run [app name] with an input file, include task tracking steps, and ask before any external execution.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an inference.sh workflow for [goal] using multiple apps, with checks for cost, privacy, output storage, and social posting approval.

output_examples.input: Find a good image generation app for product concept art.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies relevant image apps, suggests checking each app detail page, and recommends running a small test before larger jobs.

output_examples.input: Help me run a long video generation job.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines sample input creation, execution with no-wait mode, task status checks, and result retrieval after completion.

output_examples.input: Compare search and LLM options available through inference.sh.
output_examples.output: The skill separates search apps from LLM apps, explains where to inspect schemas, and recommends confirming data sensitivity before use.

best_practices: Inspect app details and input schemas before running any cloud job.
Use input files for complex requests so prompts and parameters are reviewable.
Require explicit approval before billable runs, file writes, or Twitter/X actions.
anti_patterns: Running remote installer commands without verifying the downloaded script.
Submitting secrets, private documents, or regulated data as model inputs.
Allowing automated posts, messages, follows, likes, or reposts without review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an agent use the inference.sh CLI to find apps, run cloud AI jobs, and track results.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need an inference.sh account, authentication, and any required credits or provider access.

faq.question: Can it generate images and videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents image and video app examples, including FLUX and Veo workflows.

faq.question: Does it send data outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. Running apps sends inputs to inference.sh or connected providers, so review sensitive data first.

faq.question: Can it automate Twitter or X?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill mentions posting and engagement actions, so require explicit approval before any account change.
